description: This PHP class defines a database migration for the Revive Adserver, specifically migration number 122. It manages schema changes and data transformation related to the 'clients' and 'campaigns' tables, including adding/removing fields and migrating client data to campaigns.

classes.name: Migration_122
classes.description: A PHP class extending Migration, implementing specific database schema and data migration steps for migration number 122 in Revive Adserver.

methods.name: migrateData
methods.description: Performs data migration tasks: updates 'parent' field, transfers client data to campaigns, deletes old client records, and resets sequence for campaign IDs.
